Sexcapades.IO

Map your kinks. Compare with partners. Find your overlap.

Want to compare hypermaps?

18+  ·  No account  ·  Stays on your phone

Send this to a partner or lover. Map what intrigues you, excites you, and stays off-limits—then discover where you meet.

About 10 minutes to your first story or sync: complete the Quick Start and Scribe writes from your desires. No partner needed.

  1. 01Scribe — Turn your kink map into erotic stories and practical play guides.
  2. 02Compare / Blind Compare — Compare with a partner — or use Blind Mode to see only what you both want.
  3. 03You’re Not Alone — Every kink shows how common it is, with links to Reddit, FetLife, and Discord communities.
  4. 04Start small — Rate 10 topics and get value. You don’t need to finish all ~400.
  5. 05Import, don’t restart — Already did KinkTest or a Yes/No/Maybe? Import it—don’t start over.
  6. 06Share via QR — Share your map with a QR code. No account, no link, just scan.
  7. 07Subcategories & the ladder — Subcategories split the 7 biggest categories. List view starts with 3 popular topics per category (54 total). Add topics in multiples of three—each successive multiple adds about 10 minutes, based on timer data averaged over ratings—or open the full ~400.
— Yolanda
